questions.q: How should a candidate accurately describe LTV Manufacturing Corporation in an interview?
options: As a real former employer, without qualification
As a real company whose name must be kept confidential
As the fictional, illustrative capstone project completed as part of Oracle Fusion Financials training
As a live client engagement currently in progress
questions.explain: LTV Manufacturing Corporation is a fictional training capstone. The honest, credible framing names it as exactly that - hands-on training work, not a real client or employer.

questions.q: What did the CFO's six January 31 symptoms actually represent, before investigation?
options: Six confirmed root causes already fully diagnosed
Observed symptoms - a CFO's description of what looked wrong - not yet diagnosed root causes
A list of software bugs in Oracle Fusion itself
Six unrelated issues with no connection to the books at all
questions.explain: Elena Marsh's six statements described symptoms in her own words. The actual root causes behind each one had to be investigated and confirmed, not assumed.

questions.q: Which of the six root causes required no correcting journal entry in the General Ledger at all?
options: The unreversed GRNI accrual
The misapplied cash receipt
The bank-side duplicate ACH transmission, which only required the bank's own written reversal and documentation
The unposted intercompany journal
questions.explain: The duplicate transmission was caused by the bank, not LTV. The fix required only the bank's written confirmation and reversal, with no GL-side correction necessary.

questions.q: What was the actual root cause behind Subledger Accounting transactions showing status Incomplete instead of Final?
options: A missing account rule mapping for a transaction type, which was fixed by adding the mapping and rerunning Create Accounting
A duplicate bank transmission
An unreversed GRNI accrual
A misapplied cash receipt
questions.explain: The SLA issue was a missing account rule mapping, which prevented Create Accounting from generating journals until the mapping was added and the process was rerun.

questions.q: What is the single sentence that best summarizes what the capstone story is really demonstrating, according to this lesson?
options: That Oracle Fusion Financials never has configuration errors
That translating a vague complaint into specific, provable problems and resolving every one correctly is the real skill being demonstrated
That one lucky guess resolved all six problems at once
That only the General Ledger module matters in a month-end close
questions.explain: The lesson emphasizes that the core skill isn't any single fix - it's the discipline of turning a vague 'the books don't balance' into six specific, provable, and correctly resolved root causes.
